limitations: Bounded check only; semantic synonyms and implicit conditions still require structured semantic reviewer.
No real-model error rates or corpus performance inference.

postFreezeRule: After this metadata is committed, do not modify any implementation, test, prompt, schema, configuration, arm mapping, or hash in place.
